request: Remove the remaining floating separation marks from the top finial.
route: deterministic img2threejs component correction followed by source GLB export, Blender close-angle validation and optimization, optimized GLB re-import, and Unity prefab rebuild
userDecision: revision-requested because the open torus collar exposed its rear half around the narrow finial base and read as transparency
rootCause: The eight reddish finial marks were tiny copper CapsuleGeometry objects positioned above the limestone surface. They were decorative overlays rather than recessed stone detail.
changes: removed all eight FinialFlute copper capsule meshes
rebuilt the finial as one closed parameterized limestone BufferGeometry
integrated eight shallow radial channels by modulating the stone surface itself
retained the V6 capped lower-rim and upper-rim blocks with physical gaps
hardened Blender renderer consolidation so its result is independent of active child object order
limitations: Vertical wall and upper-bowl seams remain separate embedded solids rather than destructive mortar cuts.
Water jets and impacts remain runtime or review effects excluded from structural GLB and FBX geometry.
Android device performance and final user art-direction approval remain pending.
